PRE-LAUNCH PREVIEW · CONTENT & INTEGRATIONS IN REVIEW
Website Hosting and Care

Keep the website ready for business.

Support the site after launch with hosting setup, routine maintenance and a clear plan for backups, monitoring and content updates.

The problem behind the brief.

A launch is the beginning of a website’s working life. Missed updates, unclear ownership and untested backups can interrupt business.

Our approach

Review the site and hosting environment, document ownership and access, then agree the maintenance schedule, backup process and escalation route.

What we deliver.

Hosting and domain configuration

Website migrations and deployment setup

SSL certificate configuration and renewal checks

Scheduled backups and restore checks

CMS, plugin and dependency maintenance

Uptime and performance monitoring setup

Content updates and technical troubleshooting

Maintenance handover and support planning

Tools, chosen for the job

Hosting control panels · deployment tools · monitoring and backup systems

Final stack depends on your systems, requirements and budget.

Measurement

Availability · maintenance completion · recovery checks

Baselines and targets are agreed during discovery.

Good questions.

What is included in the engagement?

Hosting-provider charges, maintenance windows, support hours and response targets are agreed in writing.

How do we get started?

Share your business goal, current channels and constraints. We agree the deliverables, responsibilities, budget and schedule before work begins.

How will progress be measured?

We agree a baseline and a reporting rhythm around availability · maintenance completion · recovery checks. Targets follow discovery and the agreed scope; results are not guaranteed.
